english: Wishing you a bright and joyful Year of the Goat. May this year bring you peace, laughter, and all the warmth you deserve.
chinese: 祝您羊年吉祥如意，生活美满，笑口常开。
pinyin: Zhù nín yángnián jíxiáng rúyì, shēnghuó měimǎn, xiào kǒu cháng kāi.
short_version: Wishing you a bright and joyful Year of the Goat.
long_version: Wishing you a bright and joyful Year of the Goat. May this year bring you peace, laughter, and all the warmth you deserve. Here's to new beginnings and beautiful moments ahead.

english: May the Year of the Goat bring you blessings upon blessings — good health, flourishing fortune, and lasting happiness.
chinese: 羊年大吉，福寿绵长，万事如意，阖家幸福。
pinyin: Yángnián dàjí, fúshòu miáncháng, wànshì rúyì, héjiā xìngfú.
short_version: 羊年大吉，万事如意。
long_version: May the Year of the Goat bring you blessings upon blessings — good health, flourishing fortune, and lasting happiness. May every endeavor you take this year meet with success.

english: As the new year arrives, I wish you clarity of mind, warmth in your heart, and the quiet joy of a life well-lived.
chinese: 新年伊始，愿您心明眼亮，温暖常伴，从容自在。
pinyin: Xīnnián yīshǐ, yuàn nín xīn míng yǎn liàng, wēnnuǎn cháng bàn, cóngróng zìzài.
short_version: Wishing you clarity, warmth, and quiet joy this new year.
long_version: As the new year arrives, I wish you clarity of mind, warmth in your heart, and the quiet joy of a life well-lived. May 2027 be a year of meaningful moments.

english: Happy Year of the Goat! May your Wi-Fi be strong, your coffee be hot, and your relatives be at a comfortable distance. 🐐
chinese: 羊年快乐！愿你网速飞快，咖啡热乎，亲戚不太近。🐐
pinyin: Yángnián kuàilè! Yuàn nǐ wǎngsù fēikuài, kāfēi rèhū, qīnqi bù tài jìn.
short_version: Happy Year of the Goat — may your relatives be at a comfortable distance! 🐐
long_version: Happy Year of the Goat! May your Wi-Fi be strong, your coffee be hot, your bank account full, and your relatives at a perfectly comfortable distance. Here's to a hilarious, wonderful year ahead!

english: Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐✨ Sending you so much good luck, warm hugs, and all things wonderful for 2027!
chinese: 新年快乐！🐐✨ 愿新的一年里，你被幸运和温暖包围！
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Yuàn xīn de yī nián lǐ, nǐ bèi xìngyùn hé wēnnuǎn bāowéi!
short_version: Happy Chinese New Year 2027! 🐐✨ Sending you so much good luck!
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐✨ Sending you so much good luck, warm hugs, and all things wonderful for 2027! You deserve every bit of happiness coming your way.

english: To my dearest family — thank you for being my home, wherever I am. Wishing us all health, togetherness, and a beautiful year ahead.
chinese: 亲爱的家人，感谢你们是我永远的港湾。愿全家健康平安，温馨幸福。
pinyin: Qīn'ài de jiārén, gǎnxiè nǐmen shì wǒ yǒngyuǎn de gǎngwān. Yuàn quánjiā jiànkāng píng'ān, wēnxīn xìngfú.
short_version: To my family — health, togetherness, and a beautiful year ahead.
long_version: To my dearest family — thank you for being my home, wherever I am. Through every season, you are the constant warmth in my life. Wishing us all health, togetherness, and a truly beautiful year ahead in 2027.

english: May our family be blessed with good health, harmony under one roof, and the deep happiness that comes from being together.
chinese: 愿全家福寿安康，阖家欢乐，同心同德，共享天伦之乐。
pinyin: Yuàn quánjiā fúshòu ānkāng, héjiā huānlè, tóngxīn tóngdé, gòngxiǎng tiānlún zhī lè.
short_version: Wishing the whole family health, harmony, and happiness.
long_version: May our family be blessed with good health, harmony under one roof, and the deep happiness that comes from being together. In the Year of the Goat, may every generation thrive.

english: Sending love to every corner of our family. May this new year keep us healthy, close, and grateful for one another.
chinese: 把爱送给家人的每一个角落。新的一年，愿我们健康相守，互相珍惜。
pinyin: Bǎ ài sòng gěi jiārén de měi yīgè jiǎoluò. Xīn de yī nián, yuàn wǒmen jiànkāng xiāngshǒu, hùxiāng zhēnxī.
short_version: Sending love to our family — stay healthy and close this year.
long_version: Sending love to every corner of our family. May this new year keep us healthy, close, and grateful for one another. There is no greater gift than the people we call family.

english: Happy New Year to the family that knows all my embarrassing stories and loves me anyway. 🐐❤️
chinese: 新年快乐，送给那些知道我所有糗事却还爱着我的家人！🐐❤️
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, sòng gěi nàxiē zhīdào wǒ suǒyǒu qiūshì què hái ài zhe wǒ de jiārén!
short_version: Happy New Year to the family that knows all my stories and loves me anyway. 🐐
long_version: Happy New Year to the family that knows all my embarrassing stories and loves me anyway. You are my people and I wouldn't trade you for anything — even on the interesting holidays. 🐐❤️

english: To family — the thread that runs through every chapter. May this year write its finest pages with all of us together.
chinese: 家人是贯穿一切的那根线。愿这一年，我们共同书写最美好的篇章。
pinyin: Jiārén shì guànchuān yīqiè de nà gēn xiàn. Yuàn zhè yī nián, wǒmen gòngtóng shūxiě zuì měihǎo de piānzhāng.
short_version: To family — may this year write its finest pages with us together.
long_version: To family — the thread that runs through every chapter of life. May this year write its finest pages with all of us together, healthy and whole, sharing the moments that matter most.

english: Happy New Year, friend! Here's to more of everything that makes us laugh, and less of everything that doesn't. 🥂
chinese: 新年快乐，好朋友！愿我们的笑声更多，烦恼更少。🥂
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, hǎo péngyou! Yuàn wǒmen de xiàoshēng gèng duō, fánnǎo gèng shǎo.
short_version: Happy New Year, friend! Here's to more laughs and fewer worries. 🥂
long_version: Happy New Year, friend! Here's to more of everything that makes us laugh, and less of everything that doesn't. I'm so glad you're in my corner. Let's make 2027 a good one.

english: Happy Chinese New Year! I promise this year I'll text you back within the same week. Probably. 🐐😂
chinese: 新年快乐！我保证今年会在同一周内回你消息的。大概会。🐐😂
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Wǒ bǎozhèng jīnnián huì zài tóngyī zhōu nèi huí nǐ xiāoxi de.
short_version: Happy New Year! I promise I'll text you back faster this year. Probably. 😂
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year! I promise this year I'll text you back within the same week. I'll return borrowed items. I'll show up on time. Okay maybe just the texting thing. Here's to us! 🐐😂

english: You make life richer just by being in it. Wishing you a spectacular year filled with joy, adventure, and good things.
chinese: 有你在，生活更加丰富精彩。愿这一年，你快乐、勇敢、收获满满。
pinyin: Yǒu nǐ zài, shēnghuó gèngjiā fēngfù jīngcǎi. Yuàn zhè yī nián, nǐ kuàilè, yǒnggǎn, shōuhuò mǎnmǎn.
short_version: You make life richer. Wishing you a spectacular year ahead.
long_version: You make life richer just by being in it. Your friendship is one of the things I'm most grateful for. Wishing you a spectacular year filled with joy, adventure, and every good thing you deserve.

english: Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐💕 May your year be as wonderful as you are — which means truly, truly wonderful.
chinese: 新年快乐！🐐💕 愿你的2027年像你这个人一样美好——真的很美好！
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Yuàn nǐ de 2027 nián xiàng nǐ zhège rén yīyàng měihǎo!
short_version: Happy Chinese New Year! May your year be as wonderful as you are. 🐐💕
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐💕 May your year be as wonderful as you are — which means truly, truly wonderful. You deserve all the happiness and then some. Wishing you the best year yet!

english: Some friendships are like good tea — they only deepen with time. Wishing you a year as rich and warm as our years together.
chinese: 有些友谊如好茶，越品越醇。愿这一年，如我们友情般温暖绵长。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē yǒuyì rú hǎo chá, yuè pǐn yuè chún. Yuàn zhè yī nián, rú wǒmen yǒuqíng bān wēnnuǎn miáncháng.
short_version: Some friendships, like good tea, only deepen with time. Wishing you a warm year ahead.
long_version: Some friendships are like good tea — they only deepen with time, growing richer with each passing year. Wishing you a year as warm, layered, and wonderful as our friendship has been.

english: Wishing you and your team a prosperous New Year. May 2027 bring new partnerships, steady growth, and well-earned success.
chinese: 祝您及团队新年大吉，合作顺畅，事业蒸蒸日上。
pinyin: Zhù nín jí tuánduì xīnnián dàjí, hézuò shùnchàng, shìyè zhēngzhēng rìshàng.
short_version: Wishing you and your team a prosperous New Year ahead.
long_version: Wishing you and your team a prosperous New Year. May 2027 bring new partnerships, steady growth, and the kind of well-earned success that comes from doing things right. Looking forward to what we can achieve together.

english: Best wishes for the Year of the Goat. May your business thrive, your decisions be sound, and your year be full of momentum.
chinese: 祝您羊年生意兴隆，决策英明，事业腾飞，马到成功。
pinyin: Zhù nín yángnián shēngyi xīnglóng, juécè yīngmíng, shìyè téngfēi, mǎ dào chénggōng.
short_version: Best wishes — may your business thrive and your year be full of momentum.
long_version: Best wishes for the Year of the Goat. May your business thrive, your decisions be sound, and your year be full of the kind of momentum that makes everything possible. Thank you for a wonderful partnership.

english: Thank you for a great year of collaboration. Wishing your whole team a restful holiday and an energizing new year ahead.
chinese: 感谢这一年的精诚合作。祝您及团队假期愉快，新年活力满满，再创佳绩。
pinyin: Gǎnxiè zhè yī nián de jīngchéng hézuò. Zhù nín jí tuánduì jiàqī yúkuài, xīnnián huólì mǎnmǎn.
short_version: Thank you for a great year. Wishing your team a restful holiday and energizing new year.
long_version: Thank you for a great year of collaboration. It's been a genuine pleasure working alongside your team. Wishing everyone a restful holiday season and a truly energizing new year filled with exciting possibilities.

english: It has been a privilege working with you this year. Wishing you a wonderful Chinese New Year and a successful 2027.
chinese: 感谢您过去一年的信任与支持，祝您新年快乐，2027年一切顺利，事业有成。
pinyin: Gǎnxiè nín guòqù yī nián de xìnrèn yǔ zhīchí, zhù nín xīnnián kuàilè.
short_version: It has been a privilege working with you. Wishing you a wonderful New Year.
long_version: It has been a genuine privilege working with you this year. Your trust means a great deal to us. Wishing you a wonderful Chinese New Year and every success in 2027. We look forward to continuing our work together.

english: On behalf of our team, warmest wishes for the Chinese New Year. We are grateful for your continued support and partnership.
chinese: 代表我们团队，向您致以最诚挚的新年祝福，感谢您一如既往的支持与信任。
pinyin: Dàibiǎo wǒmen tuánduì, xiàng nín zhì yǐ zuì chéngzhì de xīnnián zhùfú.
short_version: Warmest wishes for the Chinese New Year from our entire team.
long_version: On behalf of our entire team, we extend our warmest wishes for the Chinese New Year. Your continued support and partnership have been invaluable. We look forward to serving you well in 2027 and beyond.

english: Happy New Year to the person who makes every year worth celebrating. Here's to more adventures, laughter, and quiet moments — with you.
chinese: 新年快乐，送给让每一年都值得庆祝的你。愿我们共度更多美好时光。
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, sòng gěi ràng měi yī nián dōu zhídé qìngzhù de nǐ. Yuàn wǒmen gòngdù gèng duō měihǎo shíguāng.
short_version: Happy New Year to the person who makes every year worth celebrating.
long_version: Happy New Year to the person who makes every year worth celebrating. You are the reason ordinary days feel extraordinary. Here's to more adventures, laughter, and quiet moments together in 2027.

english: Another year, and I still choose you. May this one be our best chapter yet.
chinese: 又是新的一年，我依然选择你。愿这一年，是我们最美好的篇章。
pinyin: Yòu shì xīn de yī nián, wǒ yīrán xuǎnzé nǐ. Yuàn zhè yī nián, shì wǒmen zuì měihǎo de piānzhāng.
short_version: Another year, and I still choose you. May this be our best chapter yet.
long_version: Another year, and I still choose you — without hesitation, without reservation. May 2027 be our best chapter yet, written together, one beautiful day at a time.

english: Happy Chinese New Year, my love! 🐐💕 May this year be as sweet as you are (very sweet, to be clear).
chinese: 新年快乐，我的心肝！🐐💕 愿这一年像你一样甜甜的（真的很甜）。
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, wǒ de xīngān! Yuàn zhè yī nián xiàng nǐ yīyàng tiántián de.
short_version: Happy Chinese New Year, my love! 🐐💕 May this year be as sweet as you are.
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year, my love! 🐐💕 May this year be as sweet as you are — which is very, very sweet, to be perfectly clear. Thank you for making every day better. Here's to us!

english: Happy New Year! Legally, I'm required to wish you well. Also, I genuinely mean it. 😂❤️
chinese: 新年快乐！法律上我有义务祝你幸福，而且我是真心的。😂❤️
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Fǎlǜ shàng wǒ yǒu yìwù zhù nǐ xìngfú, érqiě wǒ shì zhēnxīn de.
short_version: Happy New Year! Legally required to wish you well. Also, genuinely mean it. 😂❤️
long_version: Happy New Year! Legally, I'm required to wish you well. Also, I genuinely mean it — every word. You're stuck with me for another year, and honestly? I couldn't be happier about that. 😂❤️

english: Happy Chinese New Year, little one! 🐐🎉 May your year be full of fun, sweets, and big dreams!
chinese: 小宝贝，新年快乐！🐐🎉 愿你的一年充满欢笑、美食和大大的梦想！
pinyin: Xiǎo bǎobèi, xīnnián kuàilè! Yuàn nǐ de yī nián chōngmǎn huānxiào, měishí hé dàdà de mèngxiǎng!
short_version: Happy Chinese New Year, little one! May your year be full of fun and big dreams! 🐐🎉
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year, little one! 🐐🎉 May your year be full of fun, delicious sweets, exciting adventures, and the biggest, most beautiful dreams. You have so much wonderful ahead of you!

english: Wishing you a new year as bright as your smile and as big as your imagination. Keep being wonderfully you.
chinese: 愿新的一年，像你的笑容一样灿烂，像你的想象力一样无边无际。
pinyin: Yuàn xīn de yī nián, xiàng nǐ de xiàoróng yīyàng cànlàn, xiàng nǐ de xiǎngxiànglì yīyàng wúbiān wújì.
short_version: Wishing you a year as bright as your smile and as big as your imagination.
long_version: Wishing you a new year as bright as your smile and as big as your imagination. The world needs curious, joyful kids like you. Keep asking questions, keep dreaming, and keep being wonderfully, completely yourself.

english: Happy Chinese New Year! Thank you for your patience, wisdom, and dedication. Teachers like you change lives.
chinese: 新年快乐！感谢您的耐心、智慧和用心付出。像您这样的老师，改变了无数人的一生。
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Gǎnxiè nín de nàixīn, zhìhuì hé yòngxīn fùchū. Xiàng nín zhèyàng de lǎoshī, gǎibiànle wúshù rén de yīshēng.
short_version: Happy New Year! Thank you for your wisdom and dedication. Teachers like you change lives.
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year! Thank you for your patience, wisdom, and genuine dedication to your students. A great teacher doesn't just teach subjects — they shape how people think and who they become. You are one of those teachers.

english: Wishing my teacher a peaceful, restful, and joy-filled new year. You deserve every good thing.
chinese: 祝恩师新年平安喜乐，好好休息，万事顺意。您理应拥有所有美好。
pinyin: Zhù ēnshī xīnnián píng'ān xǐlè, hǎohǎo xiūxi, wànshì shùnyì.
short_version: Wishing my teacher a peaceful and joy-filled New Year. You deserve every good thing.
long_version: Wishing my teacher a peaceful, restful, and truly joy-filled new year. After everything you give to your students day after day, you deserve every good thing that comes your way. Happy New Year!

english: Most of all, I wish you good health in the new year. Everything else becomes easier when we have that.
chinese: 最重要的，祝您新年健康平安。身体好了，万事皆顺。
pinyin: Zuì zhòng yào de, zhù nín xīnnián jiànkāng píng'ān. Shēntǐ hǎo le, wànshì jiē shùn.
short_version: Most of all, I wish you good health. Everything else becomes easier when we have that.
long_version: Most of all, I wish you good health in the new year. Good health is the foundation that makes everything else possible — adventure, laughter, love, achievement. May your body and mind be strong and well throughout 2027.

english: May you enjoy robust health and many peaceful years. The greatest treasure is a healthy body and a contented heart.
chinese: 愿您身体康健，岁月静好，平安是福，健康是金。
pinyin: Yuàn nín shēntǐ kāngjiàn, suìyuè jìng hǎo, píng'ān shì fú, jiànkāng shì jīn.
short_version: May you enjoy robust health. Peace is a blessing; health is gold.
long_version: May you enjoy robust health and many peaceful years. The ancient Chinese wisdom holds true: the greatest treasure is a healthy body and a contented heart. Wishing you both in abundance this year.

english: May this year see you achieve everything you've set out to do — and perhaps a few things you haven't yet imagined.
chinese: 愿这一年，您实现所有既定目标，更创造出意想不到的惊喜。
pinyin: Yuàn zhè yī nián, nín shíxiàn suǒyǒu jìdìng mùbiāo, gèng chuàngzào chū yìxiǎng bú dào de jīngxǐ.
short_version: May this year see you achieve everything you've set out to do.
long_version: May this year see you achieve everything you've set out to do — and perhaps a few things you haven't yet imagined. The Year of the Goat favors those who are thoughtful and persistent. That sounds exactly like you.

english: You've worked hard and I know this is your year. Wishing you the breakthrough you've been building toward.
chinese: 你一直很努力，我知道今年是你的年。愿你迎来期待已久的突破。
pinyin: Nǐ yīzhí hěn nǔlì, wǒ zhīdào jīnnián shì nǐ de nián. Yuàn nǐ yínglái qīdài yǐjiǔ de túpò.
short_version: You've worked hard. Wishing you the breakthrough you've been building toward.
long_version: You've worked hard and I know this is your year. All those late nights, quiet efforts, and persistent steps forward — they add up. Wishing you the breakthrough you've been building toward. This is it.

english: May wealth flow like rivers to your door, and may good fortune find you at every turn of the year.
chinese: 愿财如流水进家门，好运连连，吉星高照。
pinyin: Yuàn cái rú liúshuǐ jìn jiāmén, hǎoyùn liánlián, jíxīng gāo zhào.
short_version: May wealth flow like rivers to your door and good fortune find you at every turn.
long_version: May wealth flow like rivers to your door, and may good fortune find you at every turn of the year. Traditional wisdom says generosity opens the channels of abundance. May that wisdom prove true for you in 2027.

english: Wishing you a year of abundance — not just in money, but in time, energy, love, and the things that truly matter.
chinese: 祝您一年富足——不仅是财富，更是时间、精力、爱与真正重要的事物。
pinyin: Zhù nín yī nián fùzú — bùjǐn shì cáifù, gèng shì shíjiān, jīnglì, ài yǔ zhēnzhèng zhòngyào de shìwù.
short_version: Wishing you a year of abundance in all the things that truly matter.
long_version: Wishing you a year of abundance — not just in money, but in time well spent, energy well directed, love freely given, and the quiet satisfaction of a life that feels right. May 2027 be genuinely rich.

english: Every new year is a blank page. May you fill yours with the stories you've been meaning to write.
chinese: 每个新年都是一张白纸。愿你用它写下一直想写的故事。
pinyin: Měi gè xīnnián dōu shì yī zhāng bái zhǐ. Yuàn nǐ yòng tā xiě xià yīzhí xiǎng xiě de gùshi.
short_version: Every new year is a blank page. May you fill yours with the stories you've been meaning to write.
long_version: Every new year is a blank page. No erasures from last year, no forecasts from next year — just this open space. May you fill yours with the stories you've been meaning to write, the adventures you've been putting off, and the joy that's been waiting.

english: May this new year be the quiet beginning of something wonderful that you'll look back on with deep gratitude.
chinese: 愿这个新年，悄然开启一段美好，让未来的你回望时，满怀感恩。
pinyin: Yuàn zhège xīnnián, qiāorán kāiqǐ yī duàn měihǎo, ràng wèilái de nǐ huíwàng shí, mǎn huái gǎn'ēn.
short_version: May this new year be the quiet beginning of something wonderful.
long_version: May this new year be the quiet beginning of something wonderful — the kind of beginning that doesn't announce itself loudly, but that you'll look back on years from now with deep gratitude and a knowing smile.

english: Warmest wishes for a healthy, successful, and fulfilling Year of the Goat. Thank you for all you do.
chinese: 谨致最诚挚的祝福，愿您在羊年身体健康、事业顺遂、生活充实。感谢您的一切付出。
pinyin: Jǐn zhì zuì chéngzhì de zhùfú, yuàn nín zài yángnián shēntǐ jiànkāng, shìyè shùnsuì.
short_version: Warmest wishes for a healthy, successful, and fulfilling Year of the Goat.
long_version: Warmest wishes for a healthy, successful, and truly fulfilling Year of the Goat. May each month bring something worth celebrating, and may you end the year knowing it was well-spent.

english: Wishing you 365 days of sunshine, good food, kind people, and reasons to smile. Happy New Year!
chinese: 愿这365天，你沐浴阳光，享受美食，遇见善良的人，每天都有微笑的理由。新年快乐！
pinyin: Yuàn zhè 365 tiān, nǐ mùyù yángguāng, xiǎngshòu měishí, yùjiàn shànliáng de rén.
short_version: Wishing you 365 days of sunshine, good food, kind people, and reasons to smile.
long_version: Wishing you 365 days of sunshine, good food, kind people, and reasons to smile. May every morning feel like a fresh start, and every evening like a quiet satisfaction. Happy Chinese New Year 2027!

english: Happy Year of the Goat! May you have the stubbornness of a goat to pursue your goals and the wisdom to know when to retreat. 🐐
chinese: 羊年快乐！愿你有山羊般的坚韧追逐目标，也有适时撤退的智慧。🐐
pinyin: Yángnián kuàilè! Yuàn nǐ yǒu shānyáng bān de jiānrèn zhuīzhú mùbiāo, yě yǒu shìshí chètuì de zhìhuì.
short_version: Happy Year of the Goat! May you have a goat's stubbornness AND the wisdom to retreat. 🐐
long_version: Happy Year of the Goat! May you have the stubborn persistence of a mountain goat when pursuing your goals, and the rare wisdom to know when to change course. Also may your grass always be greener. 🐐

english: Here's hoping 2027 treats you better than your WiFi password memory does. Happy New Year! 🐐
chinese: 希望2027年对你好点，就像你终于记住WiFi密码那样。新年快乐！🐐
pinyin: Xīwàng 2027 nián duì nǐ hǎo diǎn. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: Hoping 2027 treats you better than your WiFi password memory does. Happy New Year! 🐐
long_version: Here's hoping 2027 treats you better than your WiFi password memory does. May your year be filled with easy connections, strong signals, and zero buffering. Happy New Year! 🐐

english: Chinese New Year is a time for fresh starts and warm hearts. Wishing you both in full measure this year.
chinese: 春节是新起点与温暖心灵的时节。愿你今年两者兼得，充盈而满足。
pinyin: Chūnjié shì xīn qǐdiǎn yǔ wēnnuǎn xīnlíng de shíjié. Yuàn nǐ jīnnián liǎng zhě jiān dé.
short_version: Chinese New Year is a time for fresh starts and warm hearts. Wishing you both.
long_version: Chinese New Year is a time for fresh starts and warm hearts. It's a moment to release what hasn't served us and open space for what will. Wishing you both a fresh start and a warm, full heart in 2027.

english: 新春快乐，恭喜发财。May the wealth and blessings of the new year be yours in full.
chinese: 新春快乐，恭喜发财，红包拿来！愿财运亨通，福星高照。
pinyin: Xīnchūn kuàilè, gōngxǐ fācái, hóngbāo ná lái!
short_version: 新春快乐，恭喜发财！Happy New Year and may wealth come your way.
long_version: 新春快乐，恭喜发财 — Happy New Year and may wealth and good fortune flow your way! These words have been exchanged at New Year's celebrations for centuries. This year, may they prove especially true for you.

english: May the new year bring clarity, momentum, and opportunities worth pursuing. Looking forward to a great year ahead together.
chinese: 愿新的一年，思路清晰，势头正好，机遇不断。期待我们共创佳绩。
pinyin: Yuàn xīn de yī nián, sīlù qīngxī, shìtou zhèng hǎo, jīyù bùduàn.
short_version: May the new year bring clarity, momentum, and opportunities worth pursuing.
long_version: May the new year bring clarity of direction, positive momentum, and opportunities worth pursuing. We appreciate your partnership greatly and look forward to a productive and rewarding year ahead together.

english: To the world's greatest family — you are my favorite people to celebrate with. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐🎊
chinese: 致全世界最棒的家人——你们是我最爱一起庆祝的人。新年快乐！🐐🎊
pinyin: Zhì quán shìjiè zuì bàng de jiārén — nǐmen shì wǒ zuì ài yīqǐ qìngzhù de rén. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: To the world's greatest family — you're my favorite people to celebrate with. 🐐🎊
long_version: To the world's greatest family — you are my absolute favorite people to celebrate with. Through every holiday, every reunion, and every ordinary Tuesday, you make life sweeter. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐🎊

english: On this auspicious occasion, I send you my deepest wishes for health, happiness, and lasting friendship.
chinese: 值此吉祥佳节，谨以最深厚的祝福相赠，愿友谊长存，共享吉祥。
pinyin: Zhí cǐ jíxiáng jiājié, jǐn yǐ zuì shēnhòu de zhùfú xiāngsèng.
short_version: On this auspicious occasion, deepest wishes for health, happiness, and lasting friendship.
long_version: On this most auspicious occasion of the New Year, I send you my deepest wishes for radiant health, true happiness, and a friendship that only grows stronger with every passing year.

english: May your ambitions meet their moment this year, and may every effort you pour in come back to you multiplied.
chinese: 愿今年，你的抱负遇见时机，每一分努力都加倍回报。
pinyin: Yuàn jīnnián, nǐ de bàofù yùjiàn shíjī, měi yī fēn nǔlì dōu jiābèi huíbào.
short_version: May your ambitions meet their moment and every effort come back multiplied.
long_version: May your ambitions meet their moment this year. There is a particular kind of satisfaction in watching the seeds of careful work bloom at exactly the right time. May 2027 be that year for you — and may every effort you pour in come back multiplied.

english: Happy New Year! This is the year we both stick to our wellness goals. For real this time. Probably. 🐐💪
chinese: 新年快乐！今年我们一定坚持健康目标。这次是认真的。大概吧。🐐💪
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Jīnnián wǒmen yīdìng jiānchí jiànkāng mùbiāo. Zhè cì shì rènzhēn de. Dàgài ba.
short_version: Happy New Year! This is the year we both stick to our wellness goals. For real this time. 💪
long_version: Happy New Year! This is the year we both actually stick to our wellness goals. I mean it this time. For real. We will exercise regularly, sleep enough, eat vegetables sometimes, and absolutely not immediately break these promises. Probably. 🐐💪

english: May the Five Blessings — longevity, wealth, health, virtue, and a peaceful death — grace your household this year.
chinese: 愿五福临门：福、禄、寿、禧、财，岁岁平安，福满家门。
pinyin: Yuàn wǔ fú lín mén: fú, lù, shòu, xǐ, cái, suìsuì píng'ān, fú mǎn jiāmén.
short_version: May the Five Blessings grace your household — longevity, wealth, health, virtue, and peace.
long_version: May the Five Blessings (五福) grace your household this year: longevity, wealth, health, virtue, and a peaceful life. This ancient wish carries the fullness of what Chinese culture has always understood happiness to mean — may all five be yours.

english: May our bond deepen like the roots of an ancient tree — steady, nourishing, and enduring through every season.
chinese: 愿我们的情谊如古树根深，坚定绵长，历经四季而愈加深厚。
pinyin: Yuàn wǒmen de qíngyì rú gǔ shù gēn shēn, jiāndìng miáncháng, lìjīng sìjì ér yùjiā shēnhòu.
short_version: May our bond deepen like ancient roots — steady and enduring through every season.
long_version: May our bond deepen like the roots of an ancient tree — steady, nourishing, and enduring through every season. What we have grows more beautiful with time, and I am grateful for every year we share.

english: Happy New Year! Last year's mistakes are officially expired. The new year's mistakes haven't happened yet. Pure potential. 🐐✨
chinese: 新年快乐！去年的错误正式过期，今年的错误还没发生。这就是新年的意义。🐐✨
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Qùnián de cuòwù zhèngshì guòqī, jīnnián de cuòwù hái méi fāshēng.
short_version: Last year's mistakes officially expired. New year's mistakes haven't happened yet. Pure potential! 🐐✨
long_version: Happy New Year! Official announcement: last year's mistakes are now expired and void. The new year's mistakes haven't happened yet. We are standing in a field of pure, untarnished potential. Let's ruin it beautifully. 🐐✨

english: May you spend the Year of the Goat surrounded by people who truly see you and a life that genuinely fits you.
chinese: 愿羊年里，你被真正懂你的人围绕，过着真正属于你的生活。
pinyin: Yuàn yángnián lǐ, nǐ bèi zhēnzhèng dǒng nǐ de rén wéirào, guòzhe zhēnzhèng shǔyú nǐ de shēnghuó.
short_version: May you spend this year surrounded by people who truly see you.
long_version: May you spend the Year of the Goat surrounded by people who truly see you and appreciate you — and living a life that genuinely fits who you are. That kind of alignment is the deepest form of happiness.

english: Wishing your business a year of strong foundations, smart growth, and relationships that make the work feel worthwhile.
chinese: 愿您的事业根基稳固，智慧成长，结交令工作充满意义的合作伙伴。
pinyin: Yuàn nín de shìyè gēnjī wěngù, zhìhuì chéngzhǎng, jiéjiāo lìng gōngzuò chōngmǎn yìyì de hézhī.
short_version: Wishing your business strong foundations, smart growth, and relationships worth having.
long_version: Wishing your business a year of strong foundations, smart growth, and the kind of relationships that make the work feel genuinely worthwhile. Here's to building something that lasts.

english: Your support means more than a business transaction — it's the foundation of something we genuinely value. Thank you, and Happy New Year.
chinese: 您的支持远不止是一场交易——它是我们真心珍视的根基。感谢您，新年快乐。
pinyin: Nín de zhīchí yuǎn bùzhǐ shì yī chǎng jiāoyì — tā shì wǒmen zhēnxīn zhēnshì de gēnjī. Gǎnxiè nín.
short_version: Your support is the foundation of something we genuinely value. Thank you, and Happy New Year.
long_version: Your support means more than a business transaction — it is the foundation of a relationship we genuinely value and intend to honor. Thank you for your trust this year. Wishing you a wonderful Chinese New Year and a prosperous 2027.

english: May 2027 be the year your autocorrect actually helps you. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐📱
chinese: 愿2027年，你的自动纠错功能真正帮到你。新年快乐！🐐📱
pinyin: Yuàn 2027 nián, nǐ de zìdòng jiūcuò gōngnéng zhēnzhèng bāng dào nǐ. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: May 2027 be the year your autocorrect actually helps you. Happy New Year! 🐐📱
long_version: May 2027 be the year your autocorrect actually helps you, your meetings end on time, your packages arrive undamaged, and the person in front of you always chooses the fast lane. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐📱

english: Happy New Year, little explorer! May this year take you somewhere wonderful and bring you back safely.
chinese: 新年快乐，小探险家！愿今年带你去美好的地方，也平安把你带回来。
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, xiǎo tànxiǎnjiā! Yuàn jīnnián dài nǐ qù měihǎo de dìfāng.
short_version: Happy New Year, little explorer! May this year take you somewhere wonderful.
long_version: Happy New Year, little explorer! May this year take you somewhere wonderful — whether that's a new city, a new skill, a new idea, or simply a new and better understanding of yourself. Here's to the journey ahead!

english: May 2027 hold more beauty than you expect and more peace than you dare to hope for.
chinese: 愿2027年，美好超乎你的期待，宁静多过你敢奢望的。
pinyin: Yuàn 2027 nián, měihǎo chāo hū nǐ de qīdài, níngjìng duō guò nǐ gǎn shēwàng de.
short_version: May 2027 hold more beauty than you expect and more peace than you dare hope for.
long_version: May 2027 hold more beauty than you expect and more peace than you dare to hope for. And when it hands you something unexpected, may you find that it was exactly what you needed all along.

english: May your bank account grow faster than your screen time. Happy Chinese New Year! 💰🐐
chinese: 愿你的银行账户增速超过你的屏幕使用时间。新年快乐！💰🐐
pinyin: Yuàn nǐ de yínháng zhànghù zēngsù chāoguò nǐ de píngmù shǐyòng shíjiān. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: May your bank account grow faster than your screen time. Happy New Year! 💰🐐
long_version: May your bank account grow faster than your screen time, your savings accumulate faster than your to-do list, and your income rise faster than the price of everything. Happy Chinese New Year! 💰🐐

english: Great teachers leave marks that outlast any curriculum. Thank you for the kind of teaching that changes how a person thinks.
chinese: 伟大的老师留下的印记，超越任何课程。感谢您的教导，改变了一个人的思维方式。
pinyin: Wěidà de lǎoshī liú xià de yìnjì, chāoyuè rènhé kèchéng. Gǎnxiè nín de jiàodǎo.
short_version: Great teachers leave marks that outlast any curriculum. Thank you for changing how I think.
long_version: Great teachers leave marks that outlast any curriculum, any test, any school year. What you gave your students is not just knowledge — it's a way of thinking, questioning, and engaging with the world. Thank you. Happy New Year.

english: Ring ring 📞 — it's 2027 calling to say your year is going to be AMAZING. Pick up! 🐐✨
chinese: 铃铃铃 📞 — 2027年打来说你的年会很棒很棒！快接电话！🐐✨
pinyin: Líng líng líng — 2027 nián dǎ lái shuō nǐ de nián huì hěn bàng hěn bàng!
short_version: Ring ring 📞 — 2027 calling to say your year is going to be AMAZING! 🐐✨
long_version: Ring ring 📞 — it's 2027 calling to say your year is going to be absolutely, completely, wonderfully AMAZING! The Year of the Goat has big plans for you. Please pick up. 🐐✨

english: The new year is a gift. It doesn't require a resolution — just an open mind and a willing heart.
chinese: 新年是一份礼物。它不需要什么决心——只需要一颗开放的心和愿意去接受的态度。
pinyin: Xīnnián shì yī fèn lǐwù. Tā bù xūyào shénme juéxīn — zhǐ xūyào yī kē kāifàng de xīn.
short_version: The new year is a gift. Just bring an open mind and a willing heart.
long_version: The new year is a gift. It doesn't require a resolution, a plan, or a transformation. It only asks for an open mind and a willing heart — ready to receive whatever this season has in store. May yours be wide open.

english: May the Year of the Goat bring you 步步高升 — steady advancement in all things you pursue.
chinese: 愿您羊年步步高升，鸿运当头，事事顺心。
pinyin: Yuàn nín yángnián bùbù gāoshēng, hóngyùn dāng tóu, shìshì shùnxīn.
short_version: 步步高升 — may you advance steadily in all you pursue this year.
long_version: May the Year of the Goat bring you 步步高升 — the steady, reliable advancement that comes from consistent effort and clear intent. May each step you take this year carry you higher than the last.

english: In Chinese tradition, the new year is above all a family celebration. May ours be filled with togetherness, good food, and deep love.
chinese: 华夏传统中，新年首要是阖家团圆。愿我们家人相聚，共享美食，情深意长。
pinyin: Huáxià chuántǒng zhōng, xīnnián shǒuyào shì héjiā tuányuán.
short_version: The new year is a family celebration. May ours be filled with togetherness and deep love.
long_version: In Chinese tradition, the new year is above all a celebration of family — togetherness at the table, love passed between generations, and the renewal of the ties that bind us. May ours be filled with all of that and more.

english: Starting a new year beside you feels like the best gift I could ask for. Thank you for being mine. Happy New Year, love.
chinese: 和你一起迎接新年，是我能求的最好的礼物。谢谢你是我的人。新年快乐，亲爱的。
pinyin: Hé nǐ yīqǐ yíngjiē xīnnián, shì wǒ néng qiú de zuì hǎo de lǐwù.
short_version: Starting a new year beside you is the best gift. Thank you for being mine. Happy New Year, love.
long_version: Starting a new year beside you feels like the best gift I could possibly ask for. Through all the changes and all the noise of life, coming home to you is the constant that makes everything right. Thank you for being mine. Happy New Year, love.

english: May 2027 be the year your LinkedIn profile starts getting the attention it deserves. Happy New Year, overachiever! 🐐
chinese: 愿2027年，你的LinkedIn个人主页终于得到应有的关注。新年快乐，卷王！🐐
pinyin: Yuàn 2027 nián, nǐ de gèrén zhǔyè zhōngyú dédào yīngyǒu de guānzhù. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: May 2027 be the year your LinkedIn profile gets the attention it deserves. Happy New Year! 🐐
long_version: May 2027 be the year your LinkedIn profile starts getting the attention it deserves, your emails get replied to promptly, your ideas get the credit they're owed, and your salary reflects your actual value. Happy New Year, overachiever! 🐐

english: Wherever this new year takes you, I hope you find exactly what you need — and a few things you didn't know you were looking for.
chinese: 无论新年把你带到哪里，愿你找到你所需要的一切，还有一些你没料到会找到的东西。
pinyin: Wúlùn xīnnián bǎ nǐ dài dào nǎlǐ, yuàn nǐ zhǎodào nǐ suǒ xūyào de yīqiè.
short_version: I hope this year takes you where you need to go — and a few places you didn't expect.
long_version: Wherever this new year takes you, I hope you find exactly what you need — and a few beautiful, unexpected things you didn't know you were looking for. The best discoveries are the ones we don't plan for.

english: May your work in the coming year be purposeful, your partnerships generative, and your results speak clearly for themselves.
chinese: 愿您来年的工作有意义，合作富有创造力，成果不言而喻。
pinyin: Yuàn nín lái nián de gōngzuò yǒu yìyì, hézuò fùyǒu chuàngzàolì, chéngguǒ bùyán ér yù.
short_version: May your work be purposeful, your partnerships generative, and your results speak for themselves.
long_version: May your work in the coming year be purposeful — the kind that leaves you satisfied at the end of the day. May your partnerships be generative and your results the kind that speak clearly and compellingly for themselves.

english: Above wealth and achievement, I wish you the foundation that makes all else possible: genuine, lasting good health.
chinese: 在财富与成就之上，愿您拥有一切的根基：真正持久的健康。
pinyin: Zài cáifù yǔ chéngjiù zhī shàng, yuàn nín yōngyǒu yīqiè de gēnjī: zhēnzhèng chíjiǔ de jiànkāng.
short_version: Above wealth and achievement, I wish you the foundation of all else: genuine, lasting good health.
long_version: Above wealth and achievement and all other blessings, I wish you the one foundation that makes all else possible: genuine, lasting good health. May your body be strong, your mind clear, and your spirit resilient through every season of 2027.

english: New year, same you — which is actually great, because you're pretty fantastic. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐
chinese: 新年，还是原来的你——其实挺好的，因为你真的很不错。新年快乐！🐐
pinyin: Xīnnián, háishi yuánlái de nǐ — qíshí tǐng hǎo de, yīnwèi nǐ zhēn de hěn bùcuò. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: New year, same you — which is actually great, because you're fantastic. Happy New Year! 🐐
long_version: New year, same you — which is actually wonderful news, because the you from last year was already pretty fantastic. Any improvements are just a bonus. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐

english: Happy Chinese New Year, little star! ⭐🐐 May this year be full of your favorite things and lots of surprises!
chinese: 新年快乐，小明星！⭐🐐 愿今年满是你最爱的事物和好多惊喜！
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, xiǎo míngxīng! Yuàn jīnnián mǎn shì nǐ zuì ài de shìwù hé hǎoduō jīngxǐ!
short_version: Happy Chinese New Year, little star! ⭐🐐 May this year be full of your favorite things!
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year, little star! ⭐🐐 May this year be absolutely packed with your favorite things — adventures, games, discoveries, delicious food, good books, and lots and lots of wonderful surprises. The world is yours to explore!

english: Wishing you a year of strong momentum, clear purpose, and results that reflect the quality of your work.
chinese: 愿您新年势头强劲，目标明确，成果彰显您工作的品质与价值。
pinyin: Yuàn nín xīnnián shìtou qiángjìng, mùbiāo míngquè, chéngguǒ zhāngxiǎn nín gōngzuò de pǐnzhì.
short_version: Wishing you a year of strong momentum, clear purpose, and quality results.
long_version: Wishing you a year of strong momentum, clear purpose, and results that genuinely reflect the quality and care you bring to your work. May 2027 be a year that advances your most meaningful goals.

english: May the Year of the Goat be one you look back on and say — that was a good year. A really good one.
chinese: 愿羊年成为那种你回头望时说——那一年真好，真的很好。
pinyin: Yuàn yángnián chéngwéi nà zhǒng nǐ huítóu wàng shí shuō — nà yī nián zhēn hǎo, zhēn de hěn hǎo.
short_version: May the Year of the Goat be one you look back on and say — that was a really good year.
long_version: May the Year of the Goat be one you look back on and say — that was a good year. Not perfect, not without its challenges, but genuinely good. Full of the right things. Exactly what you needed.

english: 财源广进，福如东海。May your fortune flow abundantly and your blessings be as deep as the Eastern Sea.
chinese: 财源广进，福如东海，寿比南山，万事顺意。
pinyin: Cáiyuán guǎng jìn, fú rú dōng hǎi, shòu bǐ nán shān, wànshì shùnyì.
short_version: 财源广进，福如东海 — may your fortune flow and blessings run deep.
long_version: 财源广进，福如东海，寿比南山 — may your fortune flow abundantly, your blessings be as deep as the Eastern Sea, and your years as enduring as the Southern Mountains. These are the wishes of every generation to those they love.

english: Here's to another year of tolerating each other's playlists and still choosing to stay. 🐐❤️ Happy New Year!
chinese: 又一年，互相忍受对方的歌单，还是选择留下来。🐐❤️ 新年快乐！
pinyin: Yòu yī nián, hùxiāng rěnshòu duìfāng de gēdān, háishi xuǎnzé liúxia lái. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: Another year tolerating each other's playlists and still choosing to stay. 🐐❤️
long_version: Here's to another year of tolerating each other's playlists, food preferences, and minor quirks — and still choosing to stay. Every single time. That's love. Happy New Year, my favorite person. 🐐❤️

english: 岁岁平安，年年有余. May each year pass in safety and may there always be more than enough.
chinese: 岁岁平安，年年有余，事事顺意，步步高升。
pinyin: Suì suì píng'ān, niánnián yǒu yú, shìshì shùnyì, bùbù gāoshēng.
short_version: 岁岁平安，年年有余 — safe every year, and always more than enough.
long_version: 岁岁平安，年年有余 — a wish that every year bring safety and enough. In Chinese tradition, the fish (鱼/yú) symbolizes abundance because it shares a sound with 余 (yú, surplus). May your table always hold a fish, and your life always hold a little more than enough.

english: You are the friend that makes everything more fun. Thank you for that. Happy Chinese New Year, you wonderful person! 🐐🎉
chinese: 你是让一切都更有趣的那个朋友。谢谢你。新年快乐，你这个了不起的人！🐐🎉
pinyin: Nǐ shì ràng yīqiè dōu gèng yǒuqù de nà gè péngyou. Xièxiè nǐ. Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: You make everything more fun. Thank you for that. Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐🎉
long_version: You are the friend that makes everything more fun — ordinary plans become adventures, boring evenings become memories, and everything in between is better with you in it. Thank you for that. Happy Chinese New Year, you wonderful, irreplaceable person! 🐐🎉

english: Keep going. This year, what you've been building is going to come together. I believe in it — and I believe in you.
chinese: 继续走下去。今年，你一直在建造的东西将会成形。我相信它，更相信你。
pinyin: Jìxù zǒu xiàqù. Jīnnián, nǐ yīzhí zài jiànzào de dōngxi jiāng huì chénxíng.
short_version: Keep going. What you've been building is going to come together this year. I believe in you.
long_version: Keep going. This year, what you've been quietly, patiently building is going to come together in ways you might not yet see. The effort is real, the foundation is solid, and the outcome is coming. I believe in it — and I believe in you.

english: May the rhythm of this new year suit you perfectly — neither too fast nor too slow, but exactly right.
chinese: 愿新年的节奏恰好适合你——不疾不徐，恰到好处。
pinyin: Yuàn xīnnián de jiézòu qiàhǎo shìhé nǐ — bù jí bù xú, qiàdào hǎochù.
short_version: May this year's rhythm suit you perfectly — neither too fast nor too slow, but exactly right.
long_version: May the rhythm of this new year suit you perfectly — neither too fast to savor nor too slow to feel alive. Just the right pace for doing what matters, feeling what counts, and being fully present for it all.

english: Wishing you a new year filled with the kinds of projects that challenge and inspire, and the results that make the effort worthwhile.
chinese: 愿新年充满那些既挑战又激励你的项目，以及令努力值得的成果。
pinyin: Yuàn xīnnián chōngmǎn nàxiē jì tiǎozhàn yòu jīlì nǐ de xiàngmù.
short_version: Wishing you projects that challenge and inspire, and results that make the effort worthwhile.
long_version: Wishing you a new year filled with the kinds of projects that challenge and inspire in equal measure — the ones that pull your best thinking forward and leave you proud of what you've made. And the results to match.

english: Happy New Year to someone who is going to do something amazing this year. I just know it. Keep being brave!
chinese: 新年快乐，送给今年一定会做出令人惊叹的事的你。我知道的。保持勇敢！
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, sòng gěi jīnnián yīdìng huì zuò chū lìng rén jīngtàn de shì de nǐ.
short_version: Happy New Year to someone who is going to do something amazing this year. Keep being brave!
long_version: Happy New Year to someone who is going to do something truly amazing this year — I just know it. You have more talent and courage than you realize. Keep being curious, keep being brave, and keep being yourself. The world is lucky to have you in it.

english: Sending you the biggest virtual hug and all the good luck the Year of the Goat has to offer! 🐐🤗✨
chinese: 送你最大的虚拟拥抱和羊年所有的好运！🐐🤗✨
pinyin: Sòng nǐ zuì dà de xūnǐ yǒngbào hé yángnián suǒyǒu de hǎoyùn!
short_version: Sending you the biggest virtual hug and all the good luck the Year of the Goat has! 🐐🤗✨
long_version: Sending you the biggest, warmest virtual hug I possibly can and every last drop of good luck the Year of the Goat has to offer! May 2027 treat you absolutely wonderfully. You deserve it! 🐐🤗✨

english: Home is wherever you are. Wishing our family a new year of warmth, laughter, and the simple joy of being together.
chinese: 家是有你们的地方。愿全家在新年里，温暖相依，欢声笑语，享受相聚的简单幸福。
pinyin: Jiā shì yǒu nǐmen de dìfāng. Yuàn quánjiā zài xīnnián lǐ, wēnnuǎn xiāngyī.
short_version: Home is wherever you are. Wishing our family warmth, laughter, and joy in being together.
long_version: Home is wherever you are — all of you together at a table, in a kitchen, on a call, sharing a holiday. Wishing our family a new year of that particular warmth, laughter, and the simple, irreplaceable joy of being together.

english: Dear teacher — you showed up for your students every day, and that matters more than you know. Happy New Year.
chinese: 亲爱的老师——您每天都为学生们出现，这比您知道的更有意义。新年快乐。
pinyin: Qīn'ài de lǎoshī — nín měitiān dōu wèi xuéshēngmen chūxiàn, zhè bǐ nín zhīdào de gèng yǒu yìyì.
short_version: Dear teacher — you showed up for your students every day, and that matters more than you know.
long_version: Dear teacher — you showed up for your students every single day. On the hard days and the good ones. That consistency, that care, is not a small thing. It shapes people. Thank you. Wishing you a peaceful and joyful New Year.

english: May abundance find you — not the frantic, grasping kind, but the quiet, deep kind that feels like enough.
chinese: 愿富足找到你——不是那种慌乱贪求的，而是那种沉静深厚、令人感到满足的。
pinyin: Yuàn fùzú zhǎodào nǐ — bù shì nà zhǒng huānglùan tānqiú de, ér shì nà zhǒng chénjìng shēnhòu de.
short_version: May abundance find you — the quiet, deep kind that feels like enough.
long_version: May abundance find you this year — not the frantic, grasping kind that always needs more, but the quiet, deep kind that settles into your life and makes everything feel like enough. That is the richest life.

english: Happy Chinese New Year! May your 2027 have more plot twists than a K-drama and a much better ending. 🐐🎬
chinese: 新年快乐！愿你的2027比韩剧更多反转，结局却好得多。🐐🎬
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Yuàn nǐ de 2027 bǐ Hán jù gèng duō fǎnzhuǎn, jiéjú què hǎo dé duō.
short_version: May your 2027 have more plot twists than a K-drama — and a much better ending. 🐐🎬
long_version: Happy Chinese New Year! May your 2027 have all the drama and plot twists of an excellent K-drama, but with a much more satisfying ending. You're the main character. Act accordingly. 🐐🎬

english: There is something quietly brave about welcoming a new year — about saying yes to whatever it brings. May yours bring the best.
chinese: 迎接新年是一种低调的勇敢——是对无论它带来什么都说'是'的勇气。愿它为你带来最好的一切。
pinyin: Yíngjiē xīnnián shì yī zhǒng dīdiào de yǒnggǎn — shì duì wúlùn tā dài lái shénme dōu shuō 'shì' de yǒngqì.
short_version: There's something quietly brave about welcoming a new year. May yours bring the best.
long_version: There is something quietly brave about welcoming a new year — about standing at that threshold and saying yes to whatever it brings. May yours bring the very best: growth that feels right, peace that runs deep, and joy that is genuinely yours.

english: 春回大地千山秀，日暖神州万木荣。Wishing you the warmth and renewal of a true spring.
chinese: 春回大地千山秀，日暖神州万木荣。愿您岁岁平安，春常在。
pinyin: Chūn huí dàdì qiān shān xiù, rì nuǎn shénzhōu wàn mù róng.
short_version: 春回大地千山秀 — may the beauty and warmth of spring renew you this year.
long_version: 春回大地千山秀，日暖神州万木荣 — Spring returns to warm the earth, a thousand hills bloom beautiful; the sun shines warm on all of China, ten thousand trees burst into life. May this season of renewal bring that kind of warmth and beauty to your year.

english: What a lucky thing, to spend another year beside someone who makes the ordinary feel extraordinary.
chinese: 多么幸运，又一年和一个让平凡变得非凡的人相伴。
pinyin: Duōme xìngyùn, yòu yī nián hé yī gè ràng píngfán biàn dé fēifán de rén xiāngbàn.
short_version: What a lucky thing — another year beside someone who makes the ordinary feel extraordinary.
long_version: What a lucky thing it is, to spend another year beside someone who makes the ordinary feel extraordinary — who turns a Tuesday night into something worth remembering. Here's to another year of exactly that.

english: You've been there through the good chapters and the hard ones. Thank you for being that kind of friend. Happy New Year.
chinese: 你陪我经历了美好的章节，也陪我走过了艰难的时刻。谢谢你是这样的朋友。新年快乐。
pinyin: Nǐ péi wǒ jīnglìle měihǎo de zhāngjié, yě péi wǒ zǒuguòle jiānnán de shíkè.
short_version: You've been there through the good chapters and the hard ones. Happy New Year, friend.
long_version: You've been there through the good chapters and the hard ones, the victories and the ordinary failures, the big moments and the quiet ones. That kind of friendship is rare and I don't take it for granted. Thank you. Happy New Year.

english: It has been a privilege to earn your trust this year. May the new year bring you continued success and many reasons to celebrate.
chinese: 能够赢得您今年的信任，是我们的荣幸。愿新年为您带来更多成功与庆贺的理由。
pinyin: Néng gòu yíngdé nín jīnnián de xìnrèn, shì wǒmen de róngyǐng.
short_version: A privilege to earn your trust this year. May the new year bring continued success and celebration.
long_version: It has been a genuine privilege to earn your trust and partnership this year. We do not take that lightly. May the new year bring you continued success, new milestones worth celebrating, and every good thing you have earned.

english: May you rise like the morning sun — steady, brilliant, and impossible to ignore. Happy Year of the Goat.
chinese: 愿您如晨阳升起——稳健、耀眼、无可忽视。羊年大吉。
pinyin: Yuàn nín rú chén yáng shēngqǐ — wěnjiàn, yàoyǎn, wú kě hūshì. Yángnián dàjí.
short_version: May you rise like the morning sun — steady, brilliant, and impossible to ignore.
long_version: May you rise like the morning sun this year — steady in your ascent, brilliant in your presence, and impossible for anyone to ignore. The Year of the Goat rewards those with grace and quiet determination. That is you.

english: Year of the Goat says: you're a star 🌟 and good things are on their way! 🐐✨ Happy Chinese New Year!
chinese: 羊年说：你是明星 🌟 好事正在路上！🐐✨ 新年快乐！
pinyin: Yángnián shuō: nǐ shì míngxīng, hǎoshì zhèngzài lùshàng! Xīnnián kuàilè!
short_version: Year of the Goat says: you're a star 🌟 and good things are on their way! 🐐✨
long_version: Year of the Goat says: you are an absolute star 🌟, good things are definitely on their way, and 2027 is going to be a seriously great year for you! Happy Chinese New Year! 🐐✨

english: Happy New Year! May your problems be small, your naps be long, and your inbox be manageable. The dream. 🐐
chinese: 新年快乐！愿你的烦恼小、午觉长、收件箱可管理。这才是梦想。🐐
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Yuàn nǐ de fánnǎo xiǎo, wǔjiào cháng, shōujiàn xiāng kě guǎnlǐ.
short_version: May your problems be small, naps be long, and inbox manageable. The true dream. 🐐
long_version: Happy New Year! May your problems be delightfully small, your naps be gloriously long, your inbox somehow reach inbox zero, and your meetings be replaced by a brief summary email. The dream is alive. 🐐

english: There are people in this world who make it better just by being in it. You are one of them. Happy Chinese New Year.
chinese: 这世上有些人，只是存在就让世界更美好。你就是其中之一。新年快乐。
pinyin: Zhè shì shàng yǒuxiē rén, zhǐshì cúnzài jiù ràng shìjiè gèng měihǎo. Nǐ jiùshì qízhōng zhī yī.
short_version: You make the world better just by being in it. Happy Chinese New Year.
long_version: There are people in this world who make it better just by being in it — who bring light to rooms, warmth to conversations, and something irreplaceable to the lives around them. You are one of them. Happy Chinese New Year. May your year be as generous as you are.

english: The peach blossoms of spring are here. May this season of new beginnings unfold for you exactly as it should.
chinese: 春来桃花盛，万象更新时。愿这新的开始，为您徐徐展开最好的一切。
pinyin: Chūn lái táohuā shèng, wànxiàng gēng xīn shí. Yuàn zhè xīn de kāishǐ.
short_version: The peach blossoms of spring are here. May this season of new beginnings unfold perfectly for you.
long_version: The peach blossoms of spring are here — that ancient, poetic marker of the new year's arrival. May this season of renewal and new beginnings unfold for you exactly as it should, bringing forward what has been waiting, clearing away what has not served.

english: As the new year begins, I wish you clear focus, meaningful work, and the satisfaction of a year well-directed.
chinese: 新年伊始，愿您目标清晰，工作有意义，享受全力以赴后的充实与满足。
pinyin: Xīnnián yīshǐ, yuàn nín mùbiāo qīngxī, gōngzuò yǒu yìyì.
short_version: Wishing you clear focus, meaningful work, and the satisfaction of a year well-directed.
long_version: As the new year begins, I wish you clear focus, work that feels genuinely meaningful, the kind of decisions you'll feel good about in retrospect, and the deep satisfaction of a year well and purposefully directed.

english: Happy New Year to the family that has seen my worst and somehow still invites me to dinner. Grateful doesn't cover it. 🐐
chinese: 新年快乐，感谢这个见过我最糟一面却还邀请我吃饭的家人。感激之情无以言表。🐐
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè, gǎnxiè zhège jiànguò wǒ zuì zāo yī miàn què hái yāoqǐng wǒ chīfàn de jiārén.
short_version: Happy New Year to the family that's seen my worst and still invites me to dinner. 🐐
long_version: Happy New Year to the family that has seen my absolute worst — the bad moods, the questionable decisions, the catastrophic haircuts — and somehow still invites me to dinner every holiday. Grateful doesn't even begin to cover it. Love you all. 🐐

english: May this year treat your body and mind gently. Rest when you need to, and thrive when you're ready. Both matter.
chinese: 愿这一年善待你的身心。累了就休息，准备好了再出发。两者同样重要。
pinyin: Yuàn zhè yī nián shàndài nǐ de shēnxīn. Lèi le jiù xiūxi, zhǔnbèi hǎo le zài chūfā.
short_version: May this year treat your body and mind gently. Rest when needed, thrive when ready. Both matter.
long_version: May this year treat your body and mind gently. There is a time for pushing forward and a time for quiet restoration — and both are equally valid. Rest when you need to, and when you're ready, thrive. The year has room for both.

english: Thank you for a year of strong collaboration. May the new year bring even greater alignment and results we can both be proud of.
chinese: 感谢这一年的紧密合作。愿新年带来更强的默契与让双方引以为傲的成果。
pinyin: Gǎnxiè zhè yī nián de jǐnmì hézuò. Yuàn xīnnián dài lái gèng qiáng de mòqì.
short_version: Thank you for a year of strong collaboration. Looking forward to even greater results together.
long_version: Thank you for a year of strong and genuinely productive collaboration. Working with you has been a real pleasure. May the new year bring even greater alignment between our teams and results that we can both be deeply proud of.

english: May 2027 be a year written in gold — bright, valuable, and remembered well.
chinese: 愿2027年如金子般书写——光明、珍贵、值得铭记。
pinyin: Yuàn 2027 nián rú jīnzi bān shūxiě — guāngmíng, zhēnguì, zhídé míng jì.
short_version: May 2027 be a year written in gold — bright, valuable, and remembered well.
long_version: May 2027 be a year written in gold — bright in its moments, valuable in what it teaches, and remembered long and warmly by everyone who lives it alongside you. Here's to a golden year ahead.

english: In all the years I've lived, this is still my favorite chapter — the one that started with you. Happy New Year.
chinese: 在我经历的所有岁月里，这依然是我最喜欢的篇章——以你为起点的那一章。新年快乐。
pinyin: Zài wǒ jīnglì de suǒyǒu suìyuè lǐ, zhè yīrán shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de piānzhāng.
short_version: In all the years I've lived, this is still my favorite chapter — the one that started with you.
long_version: In all the years I've lived, this is still my favorite chapter — the one that began with you. I wouldn't trade it for any other story. Happy New Year, and here's to writing the next chapter together.

english: May the Year of the Goat bring gentle blessings — the kind that arrive quietly and make everything feel right.
chinese: 愿羊年带来温柔的祝福——那种悄然而至、让一切变得美好的祝福。
pinyin: Yuàn yángnián dài lái wēnróu de zhùfú — nà zhǒng qiāorán ér zhì, ràng yīqiè biàn dé měihǎo de zhùfú.
short_version: May the Year of the Goat bring gentle blessings — the kind that arrive quietly and feel right.
long_version: May the Year of the Goat bring gentle blessings — the kind that don't announce themselves loudly but arrive quietly: a morning that feels right, a conversation that restores you, a day that ends with satisfaction. May many such days find you in 2027.

english: Happy New Year! I value your friendship and everything it has meant this year. Here's to many more ahead.
chinese: 新年快乐！我珍视我们的友谊以及它在这一年中的意义。愿往后更多美好岁月。
pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Wǒ zhēnshì wǒmen de yǒuyì yǐjí tā zài zhè yī nián zhōng de yìyì.
short_version: Happy New Year! I value your friendship and everything it has meant this year.
long_version: Happy New Year! I genuinely value your friendship and everything it has meant to me this year — the conversations, the support, the shared moments both big and small. Here's to many more years of exactly this.

english: Stillness, momentum, warmth — whatever this year calls for, may you find it in full measure.
chinese: 宁静、动力、温暖——无论今年需要什么，愿你都能找到，且是充足的。
pinyin: Níngjìng, dòng lì, wēnnuǎn — wúlùn jīnnián xūyào shénme, yuàn nǐ dōu néng zhǎodào.
short_version: Stillness, momentum, warmth — whatever this year calls for, may you find it in full.
long_version: Stillness, momentum, warmth, courage, clarity — whatever this year calls for, may you find it in full measure, at exactly the right moment. The Year of the Goat rewards those who are attuned to what is needed. May you be perfectly attuned.

english: Wishing you a 2027 with fewer Mondays-that-feel-like-Mondays and more Fridays-that-feel-like-Fridays. 🐐📅
chinese: 愿你的2027年少一些'感觉是周一的周一'，多一些'感觉是周五的周五'。🐐📅
pinyin: Yuàn nǐ de 2027 nián shǎo yīxiē gǎnjué shì zhōuyī de zhōuyī, duō yīxiē gǎnjué shì zhōuwǔ de zhōuwǔ.
short_version: Wishing you fewer Mondays-that-feel-like-Mondays and more Fridays-that-feel-like-Fridays. 🐐📅
long_version: Wishing you a 2027 with significantly fewer Mondays-that-feel-like-Mondays, far more Fridays-that-feel-like-Fridays, and at least one long weekend per month that nobody cancels. Is that too much to ask? Happy New Year! 🐐📅

english: May what you have be enough, and may you always have a little more than you need. That is the sweetest kind of abundance.
chinese: 愿你所拥有的已足够，而你总能多一点点。这是最甜蜜的富足。
pinyin: Yuàn nǐ suǒ yōngyǒu de yǐ zúgòu, ér nǐ zǒng néng duō yī diǎn diǎn.
short_version: May what you have be enough, and may you always have a little more than you need.
long_version: May what you have always be enough to feel grateful, and may there always be just a little more than you need — enough to share, enough to give, enough to rest without worry. That is the sweetest kind of abundance, and I wish it for you wholeheartedly.
